description: Base images are covered by the stock Dockerfile manager. The custom managers below cover the CMake FetchContent pins and the version-bearing build-cache ids, so toolchain bumps get PRs too. ONNX Runtime is deliberately unmanaged on every path: a bump must move the tarball URLs together with their URL_HASH / GRPARSE_ORT_CPU_SHA256 values and the Dockerfile cache ids, which a regex manager cannot recompute, so its PRs would fail FetchContent hash verification. The OpenVINO path (1.24.x) must also match Intel's newest onnxruntime-openvino wheel, not Microsoft's newest release. Bump ORT by hand.

customManagers.description: gRPC version embedded in the three Dockerfiles' build-cache ids (must move with the CMake pin so stale trees never mix)
